lines.text: What if you jumped into a hole... that goes straight through the center of the Earth?
No air. No friction. Just gravity, pulling you down faster... and faster.
At the center, gravity cancels to zero. But you're still moving twenty-eight thousand kilometers an hour... space station speed.
Then gravity slows you down. And exactly forty-two minutes after you jumped... you stop, right at the surface, on the other side of the planet.
Here's the weird part. The tunnel doesn't have to go through the center. New York to Los Angeles? Forty-two minutes. Across town? Forty-two minutes.
In theory, any straight tunnel, any length, takes the same time. Shorter tunnels are shallower, so gravity pulls more gently, and it all cancels out.
